slobs.connected.description: Runs when Cuebot connects to Streamlabs Desktop.

variables.sd.name: The name of the connection
variables.sd.host: The computer Streamlabs Desktop runs on

slobs.disconnected.description: Runs when Cuebot loses its connection to Streamlabs Desktop, for example when you close it.

slobs.sceneChanged.description: Runs when Streamlabs Desktop switches to another scene.

fields.scene: Only react to this scene, typed exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it. Leave empty for any scene.

variables.previousScene: The scene it was on before
variables.sceneId: Streamlabs's id for the new scene

slobs.streamStarted.description: Runs when Streamlabs Desktop starts streaming. Good for a "going live" message.

slobs.streamStopped.description: Runs when Streamlabs Desktop stops streaming.

slobs.recordStarted.description: Runs when Streamlabs Desktop starts recording.

slobs.recordStopped.description: Runs when Streamlabs Desktop stops recording.

slobs.replayBufferSaved.description: Runs when Streamlabs Desktop saves a replay clip (the last moments of your stream). This relies on an undocumented Streamlabs Desktop event; "Replay buffer started"/"stopped" use the documented one.

variables.savedReplayPath: Where the replay file was saved

slobs.streamReconnecting.description: Runs when your stream drops and Streamlabs Desktop is trying to reconnect. Handy to put up a "technical difficulties" message or warn yourself.

slobs.streamError.description: Runs when Streamlabs Desktop reports a streaming error, like losing the connection to the server. This uses an undocumented part of the Streamlabs Desktop API (its internal API), so a Streamlabs Desktop update may break it.

variables.errorMessage: What Streamlabs Desktop said went wrong

slobs.replayBufferStarted.description: Runs when the replay buffer starts recording in the background.

slobs.replayBufferStopped.description: Runs when the replay buffer stops.

slobs.studioModeChanged.description: Runs when studio mode is turned on or off in Streamlabs Desktop.

variables.studioMode: True when studio mode was turned on, false when off

slobs.sceneCollectionChanged.description: Runs when Streamlabs Desktop switches to another scene collection (a whole set of scenes).

variables.sceneCollectionName: The name of the collection now in use

slobs.setScene.description: Switches Streamlabs Desktop to another scene.

fields.scene: The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting".

slobs.getCurrentScene.description: Finds out which scene Streamlabs Desktop is showing and keeps its name for later steps.

fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the scene name, so later steps can use it as %name%. The default is slobsScene. Leave empty to not keep it.

variables.slobsScene: The scene that is showing now (or the name you chose above)

slobs.setSourceVisibility.description: Shows or hides one source (like a camera or image) inside a scene.

fields.scene: The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting".
fields.source: The source name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Webcam".
fields.state: Visible shows it, Hidden hides it, Toggle flips it.

slobs.hideSceneSources.description: Hides every source in a scene at once.

fields.scene: The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting".

slobs.streaming.description: Starts or stops your stream in Streamlabs Desktop.

fields.mode: Start begins streaming, Stop ends it, Toggle does the opposite of what it is doing now. Start does nothing if you are already streaming.

slobs.recording.description: Starts or stops your recording in Streamlabs Desktop.

fields.mode: Start begins recording, Stop ends it, Toggle does the opposite of what it is doing now.

slobs.replayBuffer.description: Starts or stops the replay buffer, or saves the last moments as a clip.

fields.mode: Start and Stop turn the buffer on or off, Toggle flips it, Save keeps the last few moments as a file.

slobs.setSourceMute.description: Mutes or unmutes an audio source, like your microphone.

fields.source: The audio source name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Mic/Aux".
fields.state: Mute silences it, Unmute turns the sound back on, Toggle flips it.

slobs.setText.description: Changes the words shown by a text source. Handy for "latest follower" or a message on screen.

fields.source: The text source name (a GDI text source) exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it.
fields.text: The words to show. You can use %variables% here.

slobs.setBrowserUrl.description: Makes a browser source open a different web page.

fields.source: The browser source name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it.
fields.url: The web address to open, like "https://example.com/alert".

slobs.setFilterState.description: Turns a filter (an effect on a source) on or off. This uses an undocumented part of the Streamlabs Desktop API (its internal API), so a Streamlabs Desktop update may break it.

fields.source: The source or scene the filter is on, exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it.
fields.filter: The filter name exactly as shown, like "Color Correction".
fields.state: Enable turns it on, Disable turns it off.

slobs.setSceneFilterState.description: Shows, hides or flips a filter that sits on a whole scene. This uses an undocumented part of the Streamlabs Desktop API (its internal API), so a Streamlabs Desktop update may break it.

fields.scene: The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting".
fields.filter: The filter name exactly as shown.
fields.state: Visible turns it on, Hidden turns it off, Toggle flips it.

slobs.setRandomFilterState.description: Picks one random filter on a source (or on the scene) and shows, hides or flips it. Fun for random effects. This uses an undocumented part of the Streamlabs Desktop API (its internal API), so a Streamlabs Desktop update may break it.

fields.scene: The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting".
fields.source: The source whose filters to pick from. Leave empty to pick from the scene's own filters.
fields.state: What to do with the picked filter: Visible, Hidden or Toggle.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the picked filter's name. The default is slobsFilterName. Leave empty to not keep it.

variables.slobsFilterName: The name of the filter that was picked (or the name you chose above)

slobs.hideSourceFilters.description: Turns off every filter on one source in a scene. This uses an undocumented part of the Streamlabs Desktop API (its internal API), so a Streamlabs Desktop update may break it.

fields.scene: The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting".
fields.source: The source name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Webcam".

slobs.hideGroupSources.description: Hides every source inside a group (a folder of sources) at once.

fields.scene: The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting".
fields.group: The name of the group (a folder of sources) in that scene.

slobs.randomGroupSource.description: Shows one randomly picked source in a group and hides the others. Fun for random reactions or images.

fields.scene: The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting".
fields.group: The name of the group (a folder of sources) in that scene.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the picked source's name. The default is randomSource. Leave empty to not keep it.

variables.randomSource: The name of the source that was picked (or the name you chose above)

slobs.flipSource.description: Mirrors a source sideways or upside down. Running it again flips it back.

fields.scene: The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting".
fields.source: The source name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Webcam".
fields.axis: Horizontal mirrors left and right, Vertical turns it upside down.

slobs.rotateSource.description: Turns a source to an angle. Fun for spinning an image.

fields.scene: The scene name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Just Chatting".
fields.source: The source name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it, like "Webcam".
fields.degrees: The angle to set, in degrees: 90 is a quarter turn, 180 is upside down. It sets the angle, it does not add to the current one.

slobs.studioMode.description: Turns studio mode on or off, or swaps the preview scene onto the stream (Transition).

fields.mode: Enable, Disable, Toggle (switch to the other state) or Transition (run the studio mode transition).

slobs.setSceneCollection.description: Switches Streamlabs Desktop to another scene collection (a whole set of scenes). It takes a moment and reloads every scene.

fields.collection: The scene collection name exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it (capitals do not matter).

slobs.getPerformance.description: Reads your stream health from Streamlabs Desktop: CPU use, frames per second and dropped frames. Handy for a "!health" command.

slobs.notify.description: Shows a notification inside Streamlabs Desktop, like a reminder only you see.

fields.type: Info, Warning or Success (changes the colour).
fields.playSound: Tick to also play Streamlabs Desktop's notification sound.

slobs.raw.description: Sends Streamlabs Desktop one command of your own and keeps the answer. For advanced users who know its remote control commands.

fields.resource: The part of Streamlabs Desktop to talk to, like "ScenesService".
fields.method: The command to run on it, like "getScenes".
fields.args: Extra details for the command, written as a JSON list like ["abc"]. Leave empty if it needs none.
fields.resultArgument: The name of the variable that will hold the answer as text. The default is slobsResult. Leave empty to not keep it.

variables.slobsResult: The answer as JSON text (or the name you chose above)
